messages.author: 58dfb403363c43af
messages.subject: calculateDiffMeth when P=0
parts:
Hi,

I'm getting the following warning while running calculateDiffMeth function.

glm.fit: algorithm did not converge
glm.fit/; fitted probabilities numerically 0 or 1 occurred.

The warnings disappeared when I filtered locations with P=0 or P=1. But I'm not sure if doing that is a good idea.

I was wondering how the program handles the logistic regression model when P=0 or 1.

Thanks
Suhas

messages.author: ab8277113f65c05e
messages.subject: Re: [methylkit_discussion] calculateDiffMeth when P=0
parts:
how are you filtering the locations with P=0  or P=1? If you are referring to the cases where all the methylation values are 0 or 1 (or 100%) across all samples, this is a known issue and you can ignore the warning, you will probably get p-value =1 for those cases. If that is not the case, maybe you can try to provide a reproducible example.

Best
Altuna
